name: Garden Room
summary: A room overlooking the garden with soft light all day.
description: A serene room facing the garden, where soft light arrives early and lingers all morning. The king bed wears washed linen and looks onto the cypress trees; a reading chair sits in the corner by the window. The bathroom has a walk-in shower and handmade tile. Made for anyone after quiet, greenery and an unhurried start to the day.
